newsitem.title: USA: Amsouth Bancorp sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Amsouth Bancorp sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: AmSouth Bancorp said Thursday that it has declared a three-for-two stock split in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend payable April 30, to stockholders of record April 4.
Cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares.

AmSouth also said over the next two years it would repurchase up to four million shares of its common stock -- six million shares on a post-split basis -- to fund stock issued under the company's dividend reinvestment and employee benefit plans, or for general corporate purposes.
Approximately 350,000 shares remain to be purchased under a program authorized in 1996.
AmSouth is a regional bank holding company with headquarters in Birmingham, Ala.
